description: Creates a discount code (or an automatic promotion): percentage or fixed amount off the order, specific products, or shipping. Free shipping = applies_to 'shipping', percentage 100. Restricting to products/categories/collections makes it apply to those items only. Plain dates are interpreted in the reporting timezone.

allocation.description: 'across' (default) splits the discount over the eligible items; 'each' applies it to every unit up to max_quantity

applies_to.description: Defaults to 'items' when restricted to products/categories/collections, otherwise 'order'

code.description: The code customers enter, e.g. AUTUMN20

currency_code.description: Required for a fixed amount, e.g. czk

customer_group_ids.description: Only for customers in these groups

usage_limit.description: Total number of uses (not for automatic promotions)

value.description: Percent (20 = 20 %) or amount in major units

name: create_promotion
title: Create promotion
